slides.headline: SEVEN FREE GEMINI PROMPTS NOW HANDLE THE VIDEO WORK CREATORS WERE PAYING $500 A MONTH TO OUTSOURCE
slides.image_prompt: Sundar Pichai behind a vivid open-air market stall hung with glowing Gemini-blue phones and prompt cards dangling like prized contraband goods, conspiratorial grin wide, both hands pushing a blazing lit phone over the counter toward eager reaching hands at frame's edge. A hand-painted wooden stall sign reads 'FREE.' The Gemini logo exactly as in the reference image glows as a large backlit sign above the stall. Saturated warm yellows and greens pack the scene. Documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh on-camera flash, natural skin texture, slight film grain. Accent: electric Gemini blue against saturated market gold.

slides.headline: 1) GENERATE A REAL VIDEO WITH ONE SENTENCE
slides.body: Stock footage agencies charge $50 per clip and a freelance editor costs $75 an hour. Gemini's video model builds footage from a single sentence, no camera needed. Paste this: Generate a 10-second cinematic video clip of [describe your scene]. Smooth camera movement, natural lighting, no text on screen.

slides.headline: 2) WRITE THE 3-SECOND HOOK THAT STOPS THE SCROLL
slides.body: Creators pay $200 an hour for professional hook writing. The first 3 seconds decide whether someone watches the whole video or skips it. Paste this: Write 5 scroll-stopping hooks for a video about [your topic]. Each must land in under 3 seconds when read aloud. Lead with curiosity or a bold claim.
slides.image_prompt: Extreme close-up of a thumb hovering one centimeter above a phone screen frozen mid-video, a bright orange ❙❙ pause symbol centered on screen, dramatic hard side lighting casting a deep shadow across the thumb. The phone's edge and nothing else — no other context. No faces, no readable text. Documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh on-camera flash, slight film grain. Accent: bright orange against stark black.

slides.headline: 3) FIND 10 SHORT CLIPS INSIDE ANY LONG VIDEO
slides.body: Video repurposing agencies charge $1,500 a month for this. Every long video has ten shareable moments hiding inside it. Paste this: Here is my video transcript: [paste it]. Identify the 10 best moments that work as standalone short clips. List each with its start line and a one-sentence reason it works alone.

slides.headline: 4) BUILD A FULL 60-SECOND SCRIPT FROM ONE IDEA
slides.body: Freelance video scripts cost $300 to $500 each. One line in, one complete script out, with hook, story, and call to action already written. Paste this: Write a 60-second video script about [your topic]. Open with a 3-second hook, build through one concrete example, close with a direct call to action.

slides.headline: 5) DESIGN YOUR THUMBNAIL BEFORE YOU FILM
slides.body: Most creators design thumbnails after filming and realize the footage does not match the visual they needed. This prompt builds five thumbnail concepts first, so you film toward a proven image. Paste this: I am filming a video about [your topic]. Give me 5 thumbnail concepts I can film toward. For each, describe the exact shot, the subject's expression, and the text overlay.

slides.headline: 6) LIST EVERY B-ROLL SHOT BEFORE YOU LEAVE HOME
slides.body: Video directors charge $1,000 a day to plan shot lists. This prompt reads your script and maps every B-roll shot in shooting order so you never come home missing a clip. Paste this: Here is my script: [paste it]. List every B-roll shot I need in filming order. One line per shot describing exactly what to capture.

slides.headline: 7) WRITE YOUR YOUTUBE PAGE IN ONE SHOT
slides.body: YouTube SEO agencies charge $500 a month for this. One paste, and Gemini writes the title, description, tags, and chapter markers the algorithm needs to surface the video. Paste this: Here is my video script: [paste it]. Write the YouTube title under 70 characters, a keyword-rich description, 15 tags, and chapter markers with timestamps.

slides.headline: SAVE THIS BEFORE YOUR NEXT VIDEO
slides.body:
Pull it up when you start. Prompts 2 through 7 work free in Gemini tonight. Prompt 1 needs Gemini Advanced for the video generation.

caption:
Swipe through 👉 Seven Gemini prompts that handle the hardest parts of video creation, from generating footage to writing the page that gets your video found.

Prompt 1 generates a cinematic video clip from a single sentence using Gemini's video model, prompt 2 writes five scroll-stopping hooks for any topic, prompt 3 finds ten short clips hiding inside any long video, prompt 4 builds a complete 60-second script from one idea, prompt 5 designs five thumbnail concepts before you film a single frame, prompt 6 maps every B-roll shot in shooting order so you never come home missing a clip, prompt 7 writes the full YouTube title, description, tags, and chapters ready to paste.

Video creation used to mean three paid tools and a full day of work. The fastest-growing creators right now are not the best filmmakers. They are the ones who know what to type into a free chat window. These prompts are what they type. Running a business? DM us "AI" and we will show you what this could do for yours.
